text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.21'

    - name: Setup Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install frontend dependencies
      run: |
        cd frontend
        npm ci

    - name: Build frontend
      run: |
        cd frontend
        npm run build

    - name: Start Tavern server
      run: |
        cd backend
        nohup ./tavern-server > tavern.log 2>&1 &
        sleep 5

    - name: Get server public key
      run: |
        curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/public-key > public_key.txt
        echo "Public key:"
        cat public_key.txt

    - name: Build Imixv2 agent
      run: |
        cd agents/imixv2
        go build -o imixv2-agent .

    - name: Start Imixv2 agent
      run: |
        cd agents/imixv2
        nohup ./imixv2-agent --key-file ../public_key.txt > agent.log 2>&1 &
        sleep 3

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      run: |
        cd tests/e2e
        npm install
        npx playwright install-deps
        npx playwright install

    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: |
        cd tests/e2e
        npx playwright test

    - name: Cleanup
      if: always()
      run: |
        pkill -f tavern-server || true
        pkill -f imixv2-agent || true
```
